name: a corner of a room seen flat from the front: a pale blue wall with soft diagonal stripes, a string of pennants and a hook with a pair of headphones, a floor of planks with a baseboard, a mint beanbag cut by the left edge with a game controller on it, and a wooden crate that holds the phone on a stand; the hook is plain saturated orange
fits: anything about a phone, a console or a gadget used at home while it charges or runs hot: batteries, chargers, chips, heat, games, screens; the hero is a phone whose back flips open to show a battery of cells and a chip
recipe: flat 2D front view, no iso, one scale: a wall rect with four skewed stripe bands, a sagging string with ten triangular flags that sway, a metal hook with a band and two ear cups; a plank floor with a baseboard strip; a saggy dome path with a shade side and a seam; a rounded controller made of a bar and two lobes with a d-pad and four buttons; a crate with a lid, three slats and two posts, a trapezoid stand; the phone is a rounded slab 800 by 360 with a game screen (scrolling ground, coins, a block runner) that flips to its inside: a board, a battery of six cells with a nub, a square chip with pins and a die, and a cord that leaves through the right end
